description: Reopens a done or dismissed task, clearing its completion. reopen_reason says briefly why (required, it rides the audit row). A lead follow-up (pursuit) task is refused: reopening it can queue a message, so a person does it. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the task, reports what the original call applied, and changes nothing if the task changed since.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: reopen_task
title: Reopen a task
